segments.text: In 1962, the American marine biologist Rachel Carson published a book called Silent Spring.
It was a book that warned how much the use of chemical pesticides were destroying nature.
At the time, DDT was being used in great amounts to kill insects
But pesticides did not kill only insects
Birds, fish and human beings as well were being harmed
By the poison that accumulated in their bodies over time
Carson warned that spring might come with no birds singing
Carson's words awakened widespread public concern
The chemical industry attacked her violently and criticized her work
But her warning was eventually accepted
And the United States banned most uses of DDT
Carson's book helped inspire the growth of the modern environmental movement
Is also to preserve humanity itself
